sara-support: Customer (AcmeFin) opened a high-sev ticket — audit events appear truncated and our key-visibility API returns masked IDs after rotation. They also saw a sudden billing spike attributed to HSM sessions. ticket: #123456. Anyone seen this pattern?

ivan-kms: Which deployment? CloudHSM or on-prem? region and request id pls.

sara-support: CloudHSM (us-east-1), cluster=chsm-44, request_id=rid-9b2c. Customer says `GET /v1/kms/keys` returns IDs like `****-f3a2` and audit stream has `EVENT_TRUNCATED` entries. They attached a snippet.

mei-crypto: Hmm. We had one similar when replay-proof + long-lived session reuse caused the audit chain to collapse on the proxy. What firmware on the HSM? Any signature counter mismatches?

sara-support: CloudHSM v2.4.1. App team reported `signature_count` mismatches intermittently. They included a repro curl: 

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/kms/keys?workspace=acmefin&limit=100" 
```

Response shown had masked ids and 200ms latency spikes at list time.

jonah-sre: I pulled metrics around that request_id — hsm-proxy CPU and connection churn spike at T+00:03. Looks like many short sessions created then torn down. Billing would increase if sessions are billed per-connection. Can you ask customer for their client keepalive settings? :eyes: 

sara-support: They use our SDK with default settings. Will ask. For repro I ran a quick loop locally and saw similar masking when session creation fails mid-index: 

```
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    "https://api.redwood.example/v1/kms/keys?workspace=acmefin" &
done; wait
```

Logs: `hsm_proxy: WARN event=EVENT_TRUNCATED chain_len=3 request=rid-9b2c`

ivan-kms: If hsm_proxy truncates the audit chain it usually means the backend HSM session returned an error mid-batch. Two actionable items: 1) get full hsm_proxy logs with --debug and the exact request_id, 2) check CloudHSM control-plane for connection resets around that time. Also, try setting `session_timeout` to 600 and `session_pinning=true` in their SDK config as a mitigation.

sara-support: Customer also flagged audit retention — they expected 365 days but export only contained 90 days. Legal is poking. @legal-bot can you advise on disclosure requirements if audit gaps are confirmed?

legal-bot: We need the full export and a timeline. If customer data retention SLAs were breached, we may have to notify. Please redact any PII before sharing internally. Also capture whether key material or plaintext was ever exposed — based on current reports it appears only audit event metadata is truncated, not key material.

mei-crypto: Two more notes: 1) CloudHSM v2.4.1 has a known edge-case where large concurrent lists + rotation can cause the proxy to drop event chains; patch in runtime 2.7.3 fixes the replay-proof handling. 2) If rotation reused key blobs (bad practice), you can see masked IDs until reingestion completes. Quick mitigation: perform an explicit asymmetric key rewrap to a new key and avoid reusing key identifiers.

sara-support: Escalating to ENG-CRYPTO and SRE on ticket. Asking customer to run our debug command and attach hsm_proxy logs and CloudHSM control-plane trace. Also requested temporary increased audit retention export.

ivan-kms: For repro, run with this env and paste logs: 

```
export REDWOOD_DEBUG=1
export HSM_PROXY_DEBUG=1
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/kms/keys?workspace=acmefin&debug=1" -o /tmp/keys.json
journalctl -u hsm-proxy | grep rid-9b2c > /tmp/rid-9b2c.log
```
If we confirm it's the replay-proof truncation bug, plan: patch runtime to 2.7.3, coordinate a maintenance window for the customer, and offer a one-time audit export.

sara-support: Noted. Also flagged billing for session spike (billing-ticket #B-789). Will update customer with mitigation steps (session pinning, temp logging) and ETA for eng patch. Thanks all. :lock: :white_check_mark:

deployment-bot: [system] Added label `escalation:high` to ticket #123456 and @eng-crypto, @eng-sre were notified.
